_about: Hand labels for the 20 sample calls, written by reading every transcript. Where a call is genuinely ambiguous, every defensible answer is listed. Used by `npm run eval`.

CALL-001.note: Cancels because pests are gone; rep accepts without a real save attempt.

CALL-002.note: Mice quote $999 anchor -> $649 + $59/mo; customer must check with husband who called another company; price held until Monday.

CALL-003.note: Customer asks if tech finished; rep explains 70% exclusion done, return next Thursday. Single-speaker diarization.

CALL-004.note: Customer asks why no visit; barrier materials pending, visit on the 30th; new burrows noted.

CALL-006.note: Mice upstairs; company never scheduled quarterly visits (setup error). Tech tomorrow 11-3. Baby in home.

CALL-007.note: Outbound follow-up scheduling; customer complains tech wore camera glasses; rep promises to address.

CALL-008.note: Landlord customer, hornet nest at a rental; tech tomorrow 9-12.

CALL-009.note: Outbound: schedules metal work Monday 12-4. Single-speaker diarization.

CALL-010.note: Outbound to lead; mice/squirrels + wasps; inspection Fri 1-4; competitor (Catseye) visiting tomorrow; no price given.

CALL-011.note: Courtesy call through call screening: tech two minutes out.

CALL-013.note: Customer agreed by email; schedules first rodent visit today + follow-up, takes card. Rep reads CVV back aloud.

CALL-014.note: Mice/flying squirrels; exclusion quoted $649; inspection Wed 30th 9-12.

CALL-015.note: German roaches; flush $225; booked Sat 26th, will try for 19th.

CALL-016.note: Roaches + silverfish; $225 anchor -> $179 + $57.50/mo bi-monthly; Tue Sep 22 1-3.

CALL-017.note: Fire ants in walls; $50 inspection tomorrow 10-12, credited to treatment.

CALL-018.note: Former customer's daycare (commercial); free inspection Fri 8-10.

CALL-019.note: Outbound to Google lead; rodent noises; free inspection Mon 2:30-4:30 + waitlist.

CALL-020.note: Ants after carpet; declines plan ($250 -> $179 + $57.50/mo); books one-time $225 with 45-day warranty, Tue Sep 29 8-10.
